body_revisions.scope: Publish, route, consume and confirm before replay and flow control
body_revisions.observation: Nine full sections separate broker confirmation, consumer ACK and finalbusiness effect, then actualRabbitMQ cases, channels, prefetch, deadletters and backlogs. Error-channel ACK does not confirm the original delivery.
